clips.title: The story
paras: Tucked inside the eastern wing of the Hall of Explorers, the Library serves as Ironforge's foremost repository of historical knowledge, archeological relics, and ancient lore. Maintained diligently by the Explorers' League, it houses extensive historical tomes alongside rare artifacts recovered from digs across Azeroth.

Occupying a massive chamber within the Hall of Explorers, the Library is where dwarven scholars sift through the relics and field reports recovered by adventurers across the world. Administered by the Explorers' League, the shelves are packed with foundational chronicles detailing the War of the Three Hammers, the ancient Troll Wars, and the origins of the dwarven race. Inquiries regarding rare books or archival locations are directed to Librarian Mae Paledust.
